provides: npm workspace api/ with install, lint, typecheck and test already configured
api/: Express app factory, env validation, error handler and response envelopes, logger, Prisma client and an empty schema with migrations setup
api/src/modules/health with /health/live and /health/ready and its e2e test against PostgreSQL
api/ security baseline: helmet for JSON APIs, global and stricter auth rate limiting with injectable store and TRUST_PROXY, request timeout, per-route body limits
api/src/modules/auth: register, login, refresh, logout, me with argon2id, hashed opaque tokens, rotating refresh cookie with reuse detection, User and Session Prisma models and migration
api/ default-deny authorization: requireAuth, requireRole, assertOwned and a route allowlist enforced at composition
api/ CSRF protection on cookie endpoints (X-Requested-With header and Origin allowlist)
api/ module layout routes/controllers/services/repositories/schemas with boundary, layer, raw-sql and comment guard scripts
api/ test setup with a guarded test database, per-test truncation and supertest
api/ pagination helper (Zod limit up to 100, bounded offset, hasMore) with GET /api/v1/audit/events as reference; check:pagination fails a findMany without take
api/src/modules/idempotency: Idempotency-Key middleware (per-user key, request hash, stored response replay, 422 on a different body, 409 in progress, TTL in Postgres)
api/src/modules/audit: append-only AuditEvent table (trigger), audit.record Result helper, auth events register/login/refresh reuse/logout, no PII beyond ids and ip
api/ graceful shutdown (SIGTERM drains and closes Prisma), readiness 503 while draining, HTTP server timeouts, pino redaction with request id, all tested
api/ DB least privilege: app_runtime (DML only) and app_migrator roles via scripts/db SQL, DATABASE_URL vs MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL, db:deploy wrapper, tested with SET ROLE
scripts/db-backup.sh and db-restore.sh (pg_dump/pg_restore custom format, single-transaction restore) plus docs/operations/{base-de-datos,backup-restore,despliegue}.md
Dockerfile (multi-stage, node pinned by digest, non-root, HEALTHCHECK, prod deps only, migrate target), .dockerignore and a hardened read-only docker-compose.prod.example.yml
.github/workflows/ci.yml (typecheck, lint, check with Postgres service, npm audit --omit=dev, Docker build, actions pinned by SHA) and the check:deploy guard
